extension.summary: Standalone Stremio-style catalog/stream client for Kodi with TMDb Helper integration, Plex/Emby/Silo sources, Trakt PIN linking and scrobble.
عميل مستقل لكتالوجات وروابط Stremio داخل Kodi مع دعم مشغّل TMDb Helper ومصادر Plex وEmby وSilo وربط Trakt عبر PIN.
extension.description: Standalone Dex Hub for Kodi. Add compatible Stremio manifests, browse provider catalogs, use native Plex, Emby/Jellyfin and Silo sources, play streams with external subtitles, link Trakt, reuse Dex Hub as a TMDb Helper player, and keep a unified local continue-watching list.

Dex Hub نسخة مستقلة لـ Kodi. أضف روابط Stremio، واستخدم مصادر Plex وEmby/Jellyfin وSilo الأصلية، وشغّل الترجمات الخارجية، واربط Trakt، واستخدم Dex Hub كمشغّل لـ TMDb Helper، وحافظ على قائمة متابعة موحّدة محلياً.

extension.news: Phone setup: typed or pasted text (server address, username, PIN) is no longer wiped by the 3-second poll or when returning to the page. Add-on links paste from chats and notes: invisible direction marks and surrounding text are removed, and a /configure page link becomes its manifest. Silo pairing from the phone accepts LAN addresses such as 192.168.1.10:8090 (https was forced, so the server never answered) and links copied from the browser, adds Start over, and retries the profile list after approval. Reordered rows no longer jump back while the new order is saved. The page now opens in the TV's language on a new phone (it always opened in Arabic). Add-on catalogs can be put on the Home from the phone (+ Catalog from your add-ons), and adding an add-on offers to do it. Add-ons on the home network without https are added after you confirm on the phone. Clear messages when a Silo address is wrong or the server does not answer. Setup wizard cards no longer clip the second description line.
